framing: native vertical 9:16, fills the tall frame
style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, satire, bright midday sun, city sidewalk of stone slabs
character: plump green snail, sleepy amber eyes, long swinging eyestalks, spiral shell, fills the lower half of frame at worm level
props: striding human legs in shoes and trouser cuffs; stone slabs, a low granite curb; a rich marble building far up the street; a red high heel on a slim leg; shell shards; a paper cup
prop_continuity: snail over slab crack one 0.45, two 3.3, three 6.35 with the building still far; red heel from 6.35, shell burst 7.1, sole smeared 7.8, sole clean from 9.2
motion_rule: camera travels every window, new shot size every window; the snail oozes on and works its mouth every window, never holds a pose; the crowd legs stride past the lens every window, so the frame lives while the hero crawls

audio.lip_sync: mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
